title: bupleurum ranunculoides subvar. humile
intro: Bupleurum ranunculoides subvar. humile, commonly known as small-flowered hare's ear, is a plant species belonging to the genus Bupleurum in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum ranunculoides subvar. humile are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and diarrhea. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
